description_en: Search media assets by face image (coarse search). Input a face image to retrieve information about media assets containing the person in the image
description_zh: 人脸图片搜媒资接口（粗搜），输入一张人脸图片，搜索该人物所在媒资的相关信息
kebab_example: aliyun ice search-media-by-face --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --entity-id 2d3bf1e35a1e42b5ab338d701efa0000 --person-image-url https://0000.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/input/huangxuan0000.jpg --face-search-token zxtest-huangxuan-2023-3-7-V1 --search-lib-name test1 --media-type video --namespace name-1 --custom-filters '{"intField1":{"gte":12,"lte":13},"strField2":["cd","de"],"strField1":"abc"}' --utc-create '{"gte":1761205662998,"lte":1771205662998}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchMediaByFace

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的数据条数。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The URL of the face image
parameters.name: person_image_url

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to identify the query. You can use this parameter in the SearchMediaClipByFace operation to specify the same query conditions
parameters.help_zh: 通过该参数判断是同一个搜索条件下的分页返回，与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612891.html里的FaceSearchToken配合使用
parameters.name: face_search_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the search library
parameters.name: search_lib_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the media asset. Valid values:

image

video
parameters.help_zh:
媒资类型。取值：
image：图片
video：视频
parameters.name: media_type
custom_filters

parameters.help_en:
Creation time, in milliseconds UNIX timestamp. Use gte for greater than or equal to, and lte for less than or equal to.

Example range: {"gte":1761205662998,"lte":1771205662998}
parameters.help_zh:
创建时间，毫秒时间戳。gte大于等于，lte小于等于。
范围，如{"gte":1761205662998,"lte":1771205662998}
parameters.name: utc_create
